title: FACT Notification 2026 - Walk-in interview for Craftsman Posts
description: The Fertilizers and Chemicals Travancore Limited (FACT) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies of 01 Craftsman Posts. Interested and eligibile candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their ITI and 10th can apply for the FACT Notification 2026 . The interested applicants can attend the walk-in interview.
